scope: Read-only Terminal Base evaluation timing; no SFT queue inference, model/API/metrics call, collector run, mutation or rerun

owner_summary.seed_policy: Five distinct fixed seeds; each task/seed gets one first valid score. Infrastructure attempts are retained and are not extra credited benchmark repetitions.

live_route_ledger.queue_metric_limit: No fresh saved vLLM running/waiting metrics found. Historical maxseq8 saturation must not be claimed as the current queue state. No metrics HTTP call was made.

runtime11_completed_timing_sample.method: Read the last45 accepted_first_valid result paths from owner summary; retain the32 records routed to28085/28086. Metadata timing only, no task answers used.
runtime11_completed_timing_sample.api_time_interpretation: Recorded request wall time includes model wait/inference and client overhead, not isolated GPU decode time; not proof the present queue is full.
runtime11_completed_timing_sample.sample_limit: Bounded, nonrandom completed subset. Does not estimate all445 difficulty, remaining completion time or causal speedup from maxseq20.

known_runtime_limits.agent: Native Terminus2 multistep tmux agent with summary helpers
known_runtime_limits.source: scripts/run_terminal_baseline_v2.py and frozen native runtime configs

conclusions: The benchmark requires445 multistep task/seed executions, not89 one-response prompts.
Most sampled new-endpoint tasks exhaust the existing30-minute solving budget; model requests dominate recorded solving time, while verification is a small aggregate fraction.
Earlier transport, ENOSPC/setup, verifier dependency and native-tool failures consumed time and caused retained infrastructure retries;34 keys remain infrastructure-unscored in the snapshot.

Current new services already have maxseq20 each. Additional acceleration without changing experimental semantics should target inference throughput and avoiding infrastructure stalls; more CPU is not demonstrated to be the dominant fix.
Reducing seeds, timeout, token budget or interaction turns would shorten work but change the frozen evaluation protocol. Existing five-seed partial results cannot be reported as a complete mean/SD.
